styleException.description: generated preset-swatch inline style (style: "{primary_style}"/"{secondary_style}"/"{accent_style}" in PaletteSwatch, theme_switcher.rs)
styleException.reason: PaletteSwatch previews each preset's actual --primary/--secondary/--accent HSL values as overlapping circles; these are runtime-computed HSL triplets, not fixed classes, so they cannot be expressed as static Tailwind classes by definition -- the same reasoning already recorded for theme-builder's own live-preview inline style.

inspirationNote: No shadcn or dioxus-components equivalent; an adico-specific composition with its own generated-preview styleException, matching theme-builder's.
